title: Singly Linked List
definition: A linear data structure where elements (nodes) are not stored contiguously in memory. Each node points to the next node. Insertion at the head is O(1).
simpleExplanation: A scavenger hunt. Clue 1 tells you where Clue 2 is hidden. You can't find Clue 3 without reading Clue 2 first.
